notes: kb/Work PB5652: §2002:13.16.52.2 SR1 makes each data-name-1, identifier-1 or arithmetic-expression-1 an addend and lets the SUM keyword repeat. An addend that is an arithmetic expression holding the REPOSITORY-declared SUM intrinsic without FUNCTION (SUM OF WA + SUM(WB WC), SUM OF SUM(WB WC)) is one addend at --std 2002 (g2sum07 prints 0111 and 0110); a SUM written after a complete addend is the repeated keyword (SUM WA SUM (WB * WC) prints 1001). The lexer keeps the function reading only where the entry owes an operand (CobolLexer IsReportSumClauseKeyword / ReportOperandFollows). The other addend forms are witnessed by g2sum01. retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Grammar/Core/CobolLexer.g4#IsReportSumClauseKeyword (kb/Work PB2726 moved the lexer's @members out of CobolLexer.g4 into its superclass Parsing/CobolLexerBase.cs; the same member under its new path) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Grammar/Core/CobolLexer.g4#ReportOperandFollows (kb/Work PB2726 moved the lexer's @members out of CobolLexer.g4 into its superclass Parsing/CobolLexerBase.cs; the same member under its new path)
